messages.content: The rules say publicly shared Competition Code must be shared on this competition's forum or notebooks. If a team's paper-track Writeup (public after 12 November) links agent analysis code, does it satisfy the rule to publish that code as a public Kaggle Notebook attached to this competition and post the link here the same day? Is a public Kaggle Dataset also acceptable?
